roadmap.title: Spring: first Palaces and daily-life basics
roadmap.description: April to early June. Clear the Castle and Museum, learn Baton Pass and negotiation, meet Jose in Mementos, and knock out one-off town activities near Leblanc.

roadmap.title: Summer to autumn: Palaces, Velvet Room and town visits
roadmap.description: June to November. Clear the Bank, Pyramid, Spaceport and Casino, unlock the fusion executions, and visit Kichijoji, Akihabara and the pond.

roadmap.title: Winter: Cruiser, Mementos Depths and the true-ending route
roadmap.description: November to December 24. Reach the true-ending requirements, clear the Cruiser and Mementos Depths, and finish the stats, exams and the Reaper.

roadmap.title: Third semester: Laboratory Palace and ending
roadmap.description: January to February. Refuse every offer, clear the Laboratory Palace, evolve Morgana, and watch the true ending.

achievements.summary: Unlock all 52 other achievements.

steps.text: Earn every other achievement; this one unlocks last.

achievements.summary: Complete the Castle Palace, the first Palace.

steps.text: Play through the story and finish the @loc{Castle Palace}. You cannot miss it.

achievements.summary: Complete the Museum Palace, the second Palace.

steps.text: Finish the @loc{Museum Palace} before its 6/5 deadline.

achievements.summary: Complete the Bank Palace, the third Palace.

steps.text: Finish the @loc{Bank Palace} before its 7/9 deadline.

achievements.summary: Complete the Pyramid Palace, the fourth Palace.

steps.text: Finish the @loc{Pyramid Palace} before its 8/21 deadline.

achievements.summary: Complete the Spaceport Palace, the fifth Palace.

steps.text: Finish the @loc{Spaceport Palace} before its 10/11 deadline.

achievements.summary: Complete the Casino Palace, the sixth Palace.

steps.text: Finish the @loc{Casino Palace} before its 11/20 deadline.

achievements.summary: Complete the Cruiser Palace, the seventh Palace.

guide.context: This Palace is skipped if the story ends badly right after the Casino.

steps.text: On 11/19, refuse the offer by choosing option 1 or 2 on the second question.
Finish the @loc{Cruiser Palace}.

achievements.summary: Complete Mementos by clearing Mementos Depths and Qliphoth World.

guide.context: The 12/24 run only happens on the true-ending route. Mementos Depths has over 60 floors, so clearing Mementos areas in your free time makes it shorter.

steps.text: On 11/19, refuse the offer by choosing option 1 or 2 on the second question.
On 12/24, walk to the end of the Sheriruth path and go through the door that was locked before, into the @loc{Path of Iweleth}.
Cross the path, then clear @loc{Mementos Depths}.
Clear @loc{Qliphoth World}.

achievements.summary: Complete the Laboratory Palace in the third semester.

guide.context: The third semester only happens on the Royal true-ending route.

steps.text: Raise @mechanic{Councillor} confidant to Rank 9 before 11/17, @mechanic{Justice} confidant to Rank 8 before 11/24 and @mechanic{Faith} confidant to Rank 5 before 12/18.
On 11/19, refuse the offer by choosing option 1 or 2 on the second question.
On 12/24, pick option 1 when the thought bubble offers a deal.
On 1/9, refuse the offer.
Finish the @loc{Laboratory Palace}.

achievements.summary: Watch an ending that rolls the credits.

guide.context: The Royal true ending is the one to aim for, because other achievements need the third semester. Game-over resets after failing a Palace do not count.

steps.text: Follow the true-ending route: Councillor Rank 9 before 11/17, then refuse every deal on 11/19, 12/24 and 1/9.
Finish the @loc{Laboratory Palace}.
On the night of 2/2, pick option 1 on the third question of the Akechi conversation. In the next scene, pick option 1 on every choice.
Watch the ending.

achievements.summary: Obtain Arsène.

steps.text: Play the opening story. It unlocks on its own.

achievements.description: Established your own squad of thieves.
achievements.summary: Establish your own squad of Phantom Thieves.

steps.text: Play the story. It unlocks on its own.

achievements.summary: Complete one request in Mementos.

guide.context: Some requests are missed if you skip a certain text message from Mishima.

steps.text: Open your requests and finish any one.

achievements.description: Scored the highest on your exams.
achievements.summary: Place first in your class on any one exam.

guide.context: Exams are 5/11-5/14, 7/13-7/16, 10/17-10/20 and 12/20-12/23. December is the usual time because Knowledge must be maxed first.

steps.text: Raise @mechanic{Knowledge} to Rank 5 (Erudite). Answer class questions correctly, read books and study.
Choose one exam. On each exam day, answer every question correctly. The steps below go from the earliest exam to the latest.

On 5/11 pick Minamoto no Yoshitsune first. Second, pick Minamoto no Yoritomo. Third, pick Yoritomo won. Last, pick The weak. On 5/12 pick: Cognition; Both. On 5/13 pick: The Devil's Dictionary; Femme Fatale.
On 7/13 pick: 64 degrees; Zhuge Liang; Barbarians' heads; To offer them instead of heads.
On 7/14 pick: Red King Crab (Paralithodes); It caused confusion in the economy. On 7/15 pick: Raining cats and dogs; Demon guts.
On 10/17 pick: 32 surfaces; It used to be one color; Black and white picture. On 10/18 pick: Charles-Henri Sanson; It's a hereditary profession. On 10/19 pick: Slave labor; 3 bees in all of Europe.
On 12/20 pick: graph D; over one billion yen; having his head displayed; a performance. On 12/21 pick: Hearts; Attend. On 12/22 pick: Japan; Dreadnought.

achievements.summary: Max out all five social stats: Knowledge, Guts, Charm, Kindness and Proficiency.

guide.context: Your stat progress carries into New Game Plus.

steps.text: Reach Rank 5 in each stat. Read books, play games, watch movies and do hangouts that raise them.

achievements.description: Went to a hangout spot with someone.
achievements.summary: Go to a hangout spot with a confidant.

steps.text: Unlock a spot through a magazine, a location book, a story event or a confidant rank.
Invite a confidant to go with you.

achievements.summary: Start a romance with a female confidant.

guide.context: Pick one without extra prerequisites: Ann, Makoto, Haru, Futaba, Kawakami or Hifumi.

steps.text: Raise the confidant to Rank 9.
When the game says "choose your words wisely", pick the line that starts the relationship.

achievements.description: Maxed out one of your Confidants.
achievements.summary: Raise one confidant to Rank 10.

guide.context: Ann and Ryuji are the quickest.

steps.text: Spend free time with one confidant and pick fitting answers until Rank 10.

achievements.summary: Evolve a party member's Persona.

steps.text: Follow the Royal true-ending route.
Raise Morgana's confidant to Rank 10 before 1/10.
On 1/10, watch the Morgana scene.

achievements.summary: Obtain a Persona by negotiating with a Shadow.

steps.text: Knock down every enemy to start a @mechanic{Hold Up}.
Pick the recruit option.
Answer the Shadow's questions to match its personality.

achievements.summary: Perform a Baton Pass.

steps.text: Hit an enemy's weakness.
Choose to pass to a teammate.

achievements.description: Defeated enemies via Disaster Shadow explosion.
achievements.summary: Defeat enemies with a Disaster Shadow's explosion.

guide.context: Disaster Shadows look like normal enemies with a grey and purple tint.

steps.text: Find a Disaster Shadow in a Palace or Mementos.
Weaken the other enemies first.
Defeat the Disaster Shadow so its blast hits them.

achievements.summary: Use the grappling hook.

steps.text: Play the story. It unlocks on its own.

achievements.summary: Trigger a Technical.

steps.text: Use Ann's fire skill to burn an enemy.
Hit the burning enemy with Morgana's Wind skill.

achievements.description: Obtained a Skill Accessory from a Palace ruler.
achievements.summary: Get a Skill Accessory made from a ruler's Will Seeds.

steps.text: Find all 3 @item{Will Seeds} in a Palace. They merge into a skull item.
After the Palace collapses, take the skull item to @npc{Jose} in Mementos.
Take the Skill Accessory he refines.

achievements.summary: Obtain a Treasure Demon as a Persona.

guide.context: You need an empty Persona slot.

steps.text: Find a Treasure Demon in a Palace or Mementos. Rainy days on early Mementos floors are good.
Knock it down with its weakness.
Start the @mechanic{Hold Up} and recruit it.

achievements.summary: Perform a Showtime attack.

guide.context: The first Showtime, which the game forces, does not count.

steps.text: Fight in the Bank Palace or later. Showtime triggers at random.
When the button prompt appears, press it.

achievements.description: Traded in flowers while in Mementos.
achievements.summary: Trade flowers to Jose in Mementos.

guide.context: Flowers are lost when you leave Mementos.

steps.text: Find @npc{Jose} in the Aiyatsbus path (open after 5/8), on the floor shown by his driving cutscene.
Collect flowers on the floors.
Trade them to him for an item before you leave.

achievements.description: Traded in stamps while in Mementos.
achievements.summary: Trade stamps to Jose in Mementos.

steps.text: Collect stamps in Mementos.
Trade some to @npc{Jose} for a bonus.

achievements.description: Completely changed the cognition of Mementos.
achievements.summary: Fully upgrade one of Jose's Mementos bonuses with stamps.

guide.context: The totals are 84 stamps for XP, 50 for Money and 30 for Items.

steps.text: Collect stamps on every floor.
Trade them to @npc{Jose} until one bonus is full. Items needs the fewest.

achievements.summary: Enter a deviated floor in Mementos.

steps.text: Enter Mementos floors until a completely dark floor appears. This is random.

achievements.summary: Defeat the Reaper in Mementos.

steps.text: Stand still on any Mementos floor for about 2 minutes.
Defeat @enemy{the Reaper} when it appears.

achievements.summary: Perform a Guillotine execution in the Velvet Room.

steps.text: Fuse two Personas with the guillotine.

achievements.summary: Perform a Group Guillotine execution in the Velvet Room.

steps.text: Raise the Strength confidant to Rank 1 by doing fusion tasks for Caroline and Justine. It is available from 5/18.
Bring a Jack Frost that knows Mabufu to the Twin Wardens.
Perform a group execution.

achievements.description: Used Incense on a Persona in Lockdown.
achievements.summary: Put a Persona into Lockdown and use Incense on it.

steps.text: Raise the Strength confidant to Rank 3.
Pick a Persona and the incense, then confirm.

achievements.summary: Perform a Gallows execution in the Velvet Room.

steps.text: Secure the route to the fourth Palace's treasure.
Use the gallows to sacrifice one Persona for another.

achievements.description: Performed an execution during a Fusion Alarm.
achievements.summary: Perform an execution during a Fusion Alarm.

steps.text: Secure the route to the third Palace's treasure.
Fight in a Palace or Mementos until a red door and "I'm getting an uneasy feeling..." appear.
Go to the Velvet Room and perform any execution.

achievements.summary: Perform an Electric Chair execution in the Velvet Room.

steps.text: Visit the Velvet Room on or after 8/1.
Use the electric chair on a Persona.

achievements.summary: Clean up in Leblanc.

steps.text: Interact with the closet beside the stairs on the first floor of @loc{Leblanc}.

achievements.summary: Work a part-time job.

steps.text: Read a job pamphlet in Shibuya.
Call to apply, then go work a shift.

achievements.description: Scored a hit at the batting cages.
achievements.summary: Hit a ball at the batting cages.

steps.text: Visit the @loc{batting cages} near Leblanc in Yongen-Jaya.
Swing until you hit one ball.

achievements.description: Couldn't take the heat in the bathhouse.
achievements.summary: Pass out from the heat in the bathhouse.

steps.text: Go to the @loc{bathhouse} across from Leblanc on a rainy day.
Stay inside until you pass out. This is random, so repeat.

achievements.summary: Win the lottery.

steps.text: Buy a daily or weekly ticket at the @loc{Shibuya Station} stand.
Come back after 1 or 7 days to check it. Repeat until you win.

achievements.description: Scored a prize in the crane game.
achievements.summary: Win a prize in the Akihabara crane game.

steps.text: Go to the arcade in @loc{Akihabara} once it opens in late August.
Play once a day until you win. The result is random.

achievements.description: Sold old clothing at Furugi no Neuchi.
achievements.summary: Sell old clothing at Furugi no Neuchi.

steps.text: Get sooty clothes from Palaces or Mementos.
Sell them at @loc{Furugi no Neuchi} in Kichijoji.

achievements.summary: Play a game of darts.

steps.text: From June, go to @loc{Penguin Sniper} in Kichijoji.
Play darts. Winning is not needed.

achievements.summary: Play a game of billiards.

steps.text: Go to @loc{Penguin Sniper} in Kichijoji.
Play billiards through to the cutscene.

achievements.summary: Attend the jazz club.

steps.text: Raise the Justice confidant to Rank 4. The confidant event takes you to the jazz club.
Visit the club again at night.

achievements.summary: Visit the temple in Kichijoji.

steps.text: Go to the temple in @loc{Kichijoji} in the daytime.
Talk to the old man outside and meditate.

achievements.summary: Customize a gun at the airsoft shop.

steps.text: Raise Guts to Rank 4.
Start the Hanged Man confidant and reach Rank 1.
Ask for gun customization at the @loc{Untouchable} airsoft shop.

achievements.description: Passed time at the fishing pond.
achievements.summary: Catch a fish at the fishing pond.

steps.text: Unlock the pond by joining Ryuji on 7/6, or by reading @item{Fishpond Spotter}.
Go to the pond in Ichigaya in the daytime and play the fishing game until you catch a fish.

achievements.description: Ordered from the special menu at the maid café.
achievements.summary: Order the special menu item at Akihabara's maid café.

steps.text: From late August, go to the café in @loc{Akihabara}.
Order the most expensive item on four visits (5,000 yen each).
Order on the fifth visit to get the special menu.
